industry_vector: Vertical B2B SaaS / healthtech: appointment scheduling software for independent dental clinics, GCC (UAE + Saudi Arabia)
context_brief:
Idea: a B2B SaaS appointment scheduling product for independent (non-chain) dental clinics in the UAE and Saudi Arabia.
Goal (GIVEN): 300 paying clinics within 12 months.
Budget (GIVEN): 250,000 USD seed capital.
Team (GIVEN): 2 engineers and 1 founder who does sales. No other staff stated.
Pricing idea (GIVEN): 79 USD per clinic per month (implies ~23,700 USD MRR / ~284,400 USD ARR at 300 clinics).
Not stated: product stage (assumed pre-product or early MVP), existing customers or pilots, founder's dental-industry network, feature set beyond scheduling, Arabic/English localisation, integration with existing practice-management systems, legal entity location, payment collection method, any revenue already earned.
Timeline start date: assume the 12 months start now (Nov 2026).
Web research: not performed; all market figures must be labelled ASSUMED.
